# Cloudflare

Cloudflare is a global network designed to make everything you connect to the Internet secure, private, fast, and reliable.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cloudflare/.

## Actions

- **Create DNS record**: Create a new dns record within a specific zone.
- **Create WAF List**: Create a new empty waf list for the account.
- **Create Zone**: Create a new zone.
- **Delete DNS Record**: Delete a dns record within a specific zone.
- **Delete WAF List**: Delete a waf list.
- **Delete Zone**: Delete a zone.
- **List Account Members**: List members of a given cloudflare account.
- **List Accounts**: List all accounts accessible to the user.
- **List Firewall Rules**: List firewall rules for a specific zone.
- **List Monitors**: List all load-balancer monitors in a cloudflare account.
- **List Pools**: List all load balancer pools in a cloudflare account.
- **List WAF Lists**: Fetch all waf lists (no items) for an account.
- **List Zones** (read-only): This tool lists, searches, sorts, and filters your zones.
- **Update DNS record**: Update an existing dns record within a specific zone.
- **Update WAF List**: Update the description of a waf list (cannot update items).
- **Update Zone**: Update properties of an existing zone.
